title: Division by zero error in calculate_average function
body:
## Bug Description

The `calculate_average` function crashes when given an empty list.

## Error Message

```
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
```

## Stack Trace

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "src/math_utils.py", line 15, in calculate_average
    return sum(numbers) / len(numbers)
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
```

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Call `calculate_average([])`
2. Observe the ZeroDivisionError

## Expected Behavior

Should return 0 or raise a meaningful error message.

## Actual Behavior

Raises ZeroDivisionError without helpful context.

expected_fix.description: Add empty list check before division
